verdict.rationale: GitHub Projects is a planning and tracking tool (tables, boards, roadmaps, fields, workflows). AI-driven breakdown and explanation of code diffs is a code-review capability outside this product type. Nothing in the evidence shows Projects itself analyzes or explains diffs; the Copilot issue-delegation mention is a different capability and does not transfer.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can have AI break a code diff into focused sections with explanations of what changed and why
